candidates.harbor: Incumbent defaults; learn history only with valid final target.
candidates.warmup: Identical except learn fresh causal BTC history while target remains missing/provisional; entry guards unchanged.
candidates.edge04: Identical to incumbent except minimum model probability edge 0.04 instead of 0.03.

policy: No parameter sweep. Inspect development first, select at most one candidate, then report held-out comparison. No official score or superiority claim from a short sample. Target validation is shared data-quality correction for all strategies.
selection_rule: Keep incumbent unless a candidate improves closed-cycle cash without more incomplete cycles or materially worse drawdown on development. Any selection remains experimental; holdout is descriptive, never sufficient for broad edge or official qualification. If all tied or no trading, retain incumbent.
